name: @w6w-apps/paystack
description: Accept and verify Paystack payments, manage customers, plans and subscriptions, send transfers, issue refunds and read balances.

w6w.longDescription:
Paystack is a payments platform for businesses in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa and Cote d'Ivoire. This app lets a workflow start a checkout (initialize a transaction and hand the customer the authorization URL), verify the outcome by reference, and list or fetch past transactions.

It also manages the records around a payment: customers, subscription plans and the subscriptions on them; creates transfer recipients and sends payouts from the Paystack balance; issues full or partial refunds; and reads bank lists and balances.

Connect with a secret key (sk_test_ or sk_live_) from Dashboard > Settings > API Keys & Webhooks. Amounts are always in the currency's smallest unit (kobo, pesewas, cents).
